newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw stocks seen inching up,overshadowed by NFIs.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw stocks seen inching up,overshadowed by NFIs.

text.p: The debut of Polish National Investment Funds (NFIs) is likely to overshadow other stocks performance on the Warsaw bourse on Thursday, although analysts expect low turnover on the NFIs during first days of trade.
They said stocks should rise, following their strong performance in Wednesday's continuous trade but said they were likely to extend their 13-week horizontal trend in longer-term.

They said BRE could outperform the overall market, extending Wednesday's 9.9-percent gain on the news that Germany's Commerzbank might increase its stake in BRE to over 50 percent. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
